path.description: The file referenced in the tree

mode.description:
The file mode; one of 100644 for file (blob), 100755 for executable
(blob), 040000 for subdirectory (tree), 160000 for submodule (commit), or
120000 for a blob that specifies the path of a symlink

sha.description: The SHA1 checksum ID of the object in the tree

content.description:
The content you want this file to have. GitHub will write this blob out
and use that SHA for this entry. Use either this, or tree.sha.

url.description: The URL to get content or tree for this node.

type_.description: The type of the reference in the tree
